evidence: RUNTIME FACTS the verifier needs, and where each is stated. (1) Path /app: instruction.md:13 'Put the application in /app'; test.sh:68 refuses grading without /app/server.js. (2) Start command: instruction.md:13 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5; test.sh:97,111 runs node on that entry. (3) Port: instruction.md:13 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 'port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'; test.sh:108 PORT=3000 and probes 127.0.0.1:3000 (lines 48,136); app_context.md:4. (4) Storage/DB_PATH: instruction.md:13 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8; hireops_rules.md:201; test.sh:98-101,109 injects DB_PATH (/app/app.db or the /tmp/submission copy). (5) Health path: instruction.md:13 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10; test.sh:48 probes /api/health then /. (6) Seed: instruction.md:13,15 '/assets/seed_data.json', load once, start with no shipped database, '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime' (so the agent must copy it into /app); hireops_rules.md:204-209. (7) Accounts: instruction.md:17 password Hireops!2026 and all 10 emails with roles; matches app_context.md:8-19 and the 10 seed users/roles checked in memory. (8) Fixed clock: N-A for this task - no criterion or prompt depends on a date/time value (Activity is newest-first by order, unread uses count-based read markers, the 15-second windows are durations), so no clock fact needs stating. (9) Other launch assumptions test.sh imposes are also stated: unprivileged uid, possible writable copy, cwd other than /app, env -i with PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH (hireops_rules.md:198-202 vs test.sh:99-111); symlinks only inside /app/node_modules (integration.md:16-19 vs test.sh:72-83); dependencies preinstalled via NODE_PATH, do not install (instruction.md:13, integration.md:3-4, Dockerfile npm -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1); persistence across restart for restart_app (instruction.md:15, integration.md:8-9). Network is public, so no offline constraint is required. DELIVERABLES: every graded item traces to a public requirement. Gates: wrong password stays signed out / staff sign-in (instruction.md:17, rules section 1); shared server-backed job and card visible to an independent Observer (rules section 2). Functional (37 rows): job fields, places whole 1-50, manager must be a hiring-manager account (rules:27-29; blank-title refusal implied by 'A job has a title'); add candidate at bottom of Applied, email format and case-insensitive per-job duplicate refused at the field keeping typed text, same address on another job allowed (rules:31-36); one-stage moves, skips refused, non-drag controls (rules:47-53, instruction.md:3); arrive at bottom and up/down reorder shared (rules:57-59); reject needs reason, remembers origin, Hired not rejectable, reopen only to origin with reason cleared, undo restores reason (rules:49-51,96-97); Interview capacity, reorder inside full Interview, freed place usable, undo refused on overfill (rules:63-65,98-99); refused move put back with reason and focus on that card's controls (rules:84-85); hiring-manager/observer/candidate permissions and 401/403/404/409 statuses (rules:21-23,69-73,77-80,131-134); out-of-date move names who changed it (instruction.md:3, rules:78-80); multi-card all-or-none in board order with capacity counted for the set (rules:89-92); undo blocked by any later move/reorder/reject by anyone, a note is not a change, undo once, a later move supersedes (rules:96-100); Activity readable who/what lines with reasons, newest first, per-job filter, refused attempts add none, Observer reads (rules:18,110-113); note permissions (rules:104-106); live board, messages, unread and seen within 15 s without reload (instruction.md:5, rules:117-119); plain text, blank refused, Enter/Shift+Enter, cleared focused box (rules:138-140); 30-message pages with remaining count (rules:144-147); per-person unread, total, scrolled-up notice (rules:151-160); seen semantics including hiring manager and Observer exclusion (rules:164-166); conversation access (rules:131-134); per-conversation per-person per-browser drafts (instruction.md:7, rules:170-175); candidate wording table and privacy list (instruction.md:9, rules:179-194); candidate-email linking (rules:35-36); restart persistence without reseeding (instruction.md:15). Seed-derived expectations verified in memory: Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi / Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz; Noor's note text matches; APP-101 has 120 messages; Lena's APP-301 has 3 messages, read_count 2, third from USR-REC3, so 1 unread as hro_unread_counts states. Polish (5 rows): live update keeps open card, typed note, focus and scroll (instruction.md:5, rules:121-123); live message at newest keeps draft/focus and view (rules:156-158, instruction.md:7); earlier-message place kept (rules:146-147); failed send stays in box with explanation (rules:140); ended session prompts re-sign-in with the draft kept per person and hidden from others, unsaved note draft per person per browser (rules:106,170-175). Visual (5 likert): desktop craft only, consistent with instruction.md:11 'A clear desktop workspace is what matters' and no theme/phone layout. No graded demand lacks a public requirement; prompts disclaim route/selector/wording assumptions (app_context.md:33-34, functional prompt.md:15). Probes: an app that resolves files from cwd or ignores DB_PATH fails at launch, but that requirement is public (rules section 8), not hidden. A conforming app that returns 404 to a hiring manager for another job's conversation would miss the 403 expected by hro_refusal_status, but rules:21-23 reserve 404 for candidates and assign 403 to signed-in roles that do not reach the action, so the expectation is stated.
